missing_methods.intent: Assert title is 'Why did you open the app today?'
missing_methods.proposed_signature: assert_why_did_you_open_app_today_title(expected_title='Why did you open the app today?')
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the 'Why did you open the app today' title element to be visible, retrieve its text content, and assert that it matches the expected title string. Should raise an assertion error if the title does not match.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'why_did_you_open_app_today_title' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object
Get the text attribute from 'why_did_you_open_app_today_title' using self.driver.get_attribute with 'Name' property
Store the retrieved text in a variable (actual_title)
If actual_title does not match expected_title, raise AssertionError with descriptive message showing both expected and actual values
If actual_title matches expected_title, return True to indicate successful assertion
